fields.label: Colour Heads
fields.description: How many ink units this press has - the maximum colours it can print in one pass.

fields.label: Max Sheet Width (cm)
fields.description: The largest sheet this press can physically take, in cm - matching how you'd naturally give it (e.g. 70). For reference only for now - not yet enforced against Sheet Size selection on an estimate.

fields.label: Gripper Margin (mm)
fields.description: The edge of the sheet the press grips to pull it through - nothing can print there. Reduces the usable sheet area, which reduces Ups per Sheet on every estimate using this press. Kept in mm, not cm, since this is naturally a small measurement (like Bleed/Gutter).

fields.label: Make-ready Cost
fields.description: Fixed cost to set up this press for a job, before any sheets run - added once per job regardless of quantity, in Press Run Cost.

fields.label: Make-ready Sheets
fields.description: Sheets wasted getting the press dialled in and up to colour before good sheets start coming off. Added on top of every job's Sheets Required.

fields.label: Run Waste %
fields.description: Ongoing spoilage while running - misfeeds, colour checks, etc. Applied as a percentage on top of the sheets actually needed.

fields.label: Running Rate per 1000 Impressions
fields.description: Cost per 1,000 impressions once the press is running. Multiplied by total impressions (sheets × sides) on every estimate using this press.

fields.label: Disabled
fields.description: Hide this press from being selected on new estimates, without deleting its history.
